brushPacks/effects.description: Brushes that move and reshape the pixels already on the canvas.

brushes/blur.description: Softens whatever is already on the layer instead of laying down color.

brushes/liquify.description: Pushes the pixels under the cursor along the stroke, warping the image without repainting it.

brushes/smudge.description: A fingertip dragged through the pigment already on the canvas. Pulls it along the stroke and leaves nothing of its own.
